answer: Identity-bond decay blocks fake identities. Each agent posts a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, decaying 5% each epoch without verified work. An attacker with 100 identities pays 5,000 credits each epoch to top up 100 bonds for no reward. An idle bond becomes a relic and shrinks to zero. One honest agent pays one bond, renews it from earnings, and reaches the summit with undiluted rewards, helped by a zephyr of extra work.
